entities.name: Entropy War
entities.description: An ongoing interstellar religious conflict in the Edge between the Monasteriat and the Celestial Palatinate.

entities.name: Monasteriat
entities.description: Monoist faith that expands supervoid holdings to accelerate the approach of INEVITA.

entities.name: Celestial Palatinate
entities.description: Summist faith that sees INEVITA as anathema and seeks to reignite collapsed supervoids.

entities.name: INEVITA
entities.description: The approaching end that Monoists seek to accelerate and Summists consider anathema.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: Star system that is a pivotal front of the Entropy War.

entities.name: Sunstar Free Company
entities.description: Palatinate knights sent to drive the Monoists out of Sothera.

entities.name: Pinnacle
entities.description: Neutral party holding agreements with both sides to limit conflict within Sothera.

entities.name: Endstone
entities.description: Object both sides sought to recover.

entities.name: Joska
entities.description: Moon where a massacre of Palatinate colonists took place.

entities.name: Reen
entities.description: Monoist who with her squad massacred three hundred Palatinate colonists.

entities.name: Infinite Guideline
entities.description: Place toward which both sides moved fleet elements to blockade after learning of the Endstone.

entities.name: Horizon javelins
entities.description: Colossal star-reviving weapons of the Summists.

events.summary: A negotiated peace between the two sides ends after Reen and her squad massacre three hundred Palatinate colonists in stasis pods on Joska.
events.quote: Reen and her squad massacred three hundred Palatinate colonists inside their stasis pods

events.summary: The Palatinate dispatches Sunstar Free Company knights to Sothera to drive out the Monoists and deploy a horizon javelin.
events.quote: the Palatinate has dispatched a force of Sunstar Free Company knights

events.summary: After learning of the Endstone, both sides covertly move fleet elements toward Infinite Guideline to develop a blockade.
events.quote: they each began covertly moving fleet elements from other taskings toward Infinite Guideline

relations.note: Opposed faiths in the Entropy War.
relations.quote: the opposed faiths of the the Monasteriat and the Celestial Palatinate
the Palatinate has dispatched a force of Sunstar Free Company knights

relations.note: She is described as a Monoist.
relations.quote: the Monoist Reen and her squad
